routes.what: Earn up to $250,000 USD in bug bounty awards
routes.reward: Earn up to $250,000 USD in bug bounty awards
routes.requirements: Anyone with security-research skill who follows Microsoft's Rules of Engagement and Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure.
routes.payout_timing: Reports are triaged continuously; awards are paid after the report is validated.
catches: Only the first to identify a new vulnerability earns an award — duplicates earn nothing.
Requires real security expertise: qualifying vulnerabilities take skill and often many hours to find.
Coordinated disclosure is mandatory — you must report privately and follow the Rules of Engagement.
Responsible testing only: never access, modify, or exfiltrate customer data; never disrupt services.
Awards vary by program and severity — most hunters earn nothing per report.

steps.text: Review the active bounty programs and scope on the official MSRC bounty page.
Research vulnerabilities while working within the Rules of Engagement — no customer data access, no service disruption.
Report privately via the MSRC with clear reproduction steps, proof-of-concept code, and impact analysis.
MSRC triages the report; eligible first-reports earn awards based on program and severity.

routes.payout_value_note: Awards are set per report by program and severity; official page states awards up to $250,000 USD — variable.
routes.numeric_basis: payout: official ceiling $250,000 USD per award; awards vary by program and severity. time: reconnaissance + testing + writing a quality report, est. 90-240 min active.

routes.method: Invite friends to open Robinhood account via your link
routes.what: Share referral link, friend opens account and links bank, makes qualifying deposit
routes.reward: You'll earn a bonus stock reward each time you reach a qualifying referral milestone. You can earn up to $15,000 in bonus stock rewards per year. | Qualifying Referrals: 1 referral = $50; 3 referrals = $150; 10 referrals = $800; 50 referrals = $4,000; 200 referrals = $10,000
routes.requirements: 18+, existing account on the platform, friends who don't already have the app, no self-referrals
routes.payout_timing: Milestone bonus credited approximately one week after claiming; stock sellable 3 trading days after grant; cash value withdrawable 60 days after claiming.
catches: Referrer earns only at milestones: $50 at 1 referral, $150 at 3, $800 at 10, $4,000 at 50, $10,000 at 200 — no bonus for referrals between milestones.
Reward is stock (whole/fractional shares from a fixed list of 26 large-cap companies), not cash; cannot sell for 3 trading days; cash value cannot be withdrawn for 60 days after claiming.

Friend's signup must begin on or after September 1, 2026 at 9 AM PT to count under the current offer; friend must open an individual brokerage account and fund it with a deposit greater than $0 (merely linking a bank account does not count).
You and your friend must be US residents; you must have an active individual brokerage account in good standing; 60 days to claim each milestone reward before it expires.
$15,000 annual cap on bonus stock rewards; Robinhood can modify or terminate the offer at any time without notice.
Rewards reported for tax purposes (1099) and subject to capital gains treatment on sale.

steps.text: In the Robinhood app, go to Account (person icon) > Menu (3 bars) > Rewards to get your referral link or QR code: https://robinhood.com/us/en/support/articles/invite-friends-get-free-stock/?region=US
Send your link to a friend who has never had a Robinhood account — they must be a US resident.
Your friend opens an individual taxable brokerage account and funds it with a settled deposit greater than $0 (linking a bank alone does not count).
steps.done_when: Your friend signs up through your link.

steps.text: Track progress in the app under Rewards > clock icon; your first milestone ($50 in stock) triggers after the friend's deposit settles.
Claim the milestone reward within 60 days in the app, then pick whole/fractional shares from the 26-company list.
Wait 3 trading days to sell the stock; keep the cash value in the account 60 days before withdrawing.

Offer Period is only September 10, 2026 – September 30, 2026 — about a week left at verification time — and SoFi may modify, suspend, or terminate the offer at any time without advance notice.
Only ACAT transfers qualify — new cash deposits do not earn the match.
This offer may not be combined with any other offers.
The match is treated as taxable income; it is paid in cash but cannot be rolled into anything else.
New SoFi customers qualify only if their self-directed IRA or taxable account is in good standing through SoFi Securities LLC.

steps.text: Open or confirm a SoFi self-directed IRA (Traditional/Roth) or taxable brokerage account in good standing through SoFi Securities LLC — new accounts qualify.
Initiate an ACAT transfer of assets from your existing brokerage account into the SoFi self-directed account (new cash deposits do not qualify).
Make sure the transferred assets settle before the end of the Offer Period (September 30, 2026); transfers settling later earn nothing.
The 1% match is paid in cash into the receiving account within 5 business days of the settlement date (e.g. $20,000 transferred = $200 match).
Keep the transferred assets in the SoFi account for five (5) years from the settlement date — early withdrawal triggers a proportional fee and removal of matching funds.

routes.requirements: Positioned for limited or new credit history; Chase still requires an acceptable credit profile, and a hard inquiry applies. Widely reported (not officially published): Chase denies applicants under its 5/24 pattern with five or more newly opened personal cards in 24 months. Account must be open and not in default when rewards post.
routes.payout_timing: Promotional 3% dining rate applies to up to $6,000 of dining spend in the first 6 months from account opening. Rewards post with normal statement-cycle cash back; the $25 statement credit posts after autopay enrollment.
catches: Only claim this if you were already going to spend the money anyway; never spend extra on dining just to chase the 3% rate, because eating out you would not have paid for turns a bonus into debt.

Year-one math: the incremental welcome value is the extra 1.5% over the card's normal 1.5% dining rate on up to $6,000 in the first 6 months, which is up to $90, plus a $25 autopay statement credit, for up to about $115 total. The cap matters: dining spend above $6,000 in the first 6 months earns the normal rate.

Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which typically knocks a few points off your credit score for a short time. Chase also uses its unpublished 5/24 pattern: applicants with five or more newly opened personal cards across any issuer in the last 24 months are generally denied.
This card's APR is around 20% or higher, so carrying a balance would wipe out the bonus fast. Pay the statement balance in full every month or this offer loses you money.

The 3% rate applies only to dining at restaurants, including takeout and eligible delivery services, and only on up to $6,000 spent in the first 6 months from account opening. Other purchases earn the normal 1.5%.
The $25 statement credit is separate and requires enrolling in autopay; do not confuse it with the 3% dining offer.

Chase's unpublished 5/24 pattern: five or more new personal cards opened in the last 24 months generally means denial, even with excellent credit. The account must be open and not in default when rewards post.

Rebates are funded and can be withdrawn when funding is exhausted (Naperville: 'offered until all funding is allocated').
Demand-response enrollment bonuses (e.g., Rush Hour Rewards bill credits) are separate programs from purchase rebates — do not stack them in your math unless your utility offers both.

steps.text: Go to the ENERGY STAR rebate finder at https://www.energystar.gov/rebate-finder?zip_code_filter=27949&x=12&y=16&page_number=0 and enter your ZIP code (use the finder itself, not the example ZIP) to see smart-thermostat rebates from your utility.

Open your utility's rebate page from the finder results and confirm three things: the qualifying-model list, the purchase window (e.g., PSE: purchase/install/connect by 12/31/2026), and the filing deadline (e.g., 60 days from purchase for PSE, 120 days from installation for Naperville).
Purchase a qualifying Wi-Fi smart thermostat (check it is ENERGY STAR certified / on the qualified list) inside the window and keep the dated, paid receipt showing the model number.
Install the thermostat and register/connect it via Wi-Fi with the manufacturer, if the program requires connection (PSE does).
Submit the rebate application through the utility's portal or form with your account number, the receipt, and model number — inside the filing deadline.
Receive the rebate as a bill credit, check, or prepaid gift card; if it arrives as a gift card (e.g., SWEPCO), activate it within the stated window.

routes.what: Select your state, search, file claim
routes.reward: NAUPA on unclaimed.org: 'Yes! It is free to search for and claim your missing money! There is no fee to search for and claim your unclaimed property — if you use your official state program.' This finds money ALREADY OWED TO YOU (a forgotten account, uncashed check, security deposit) if it exists in a state database — it never promises anyone has any.
routes.requirements: 18+ (or guardian for minors), US resident, government ID, proof of address, patience for processing timelines
routes.payout_timing: Search is instant. Claim processing is handled by each state's official program — typically weeks to a few months after you submit proof of identity and ownership.
catches: Most searches return nothing — NAUPA says 1 in 10 people have unclaimed property, which means 9 in 10 do not.
Third-party 'finder' firms may legally take a percentage of your money; the official state program is always free — use it directly.
You must prove ownership with documents (SSN, old addresses, pay stubs, utility bills); a name match alone pays nothing.
Impostor sites mimic state programs — always reach the state site from unclaimed.org's map or MissingMoney.com.
Claims are verified by the state before payout, so even a confirmed match takes weeks to months.

steps.text: Go to https://unclaimed.org/search/ and use the interactive map to pick your state, or use MissingMoney.com (the free multi-state search sponsored by NAUPA) to check participating states at once.
Search EVERY state you have lived or done business in — property is reported to the state where the company resides, so matches commonly span multiple states.
If your name matches, click through to that state's official unclaimed-property program website (never a third-party finder).
File the claim on the state site and upload proof of identity and ownership (pay stub, utility bill, SSN, old address records).
Track the claim on the state site; expect weeks to a few months for verification and payout.

Provide the employment details and identity documents PBGC requests to verify you are the missing participant.
If verified, PBGC pays the benefit it is holding for you.

If the check is lost or was never delivered, initiate a refund trace — in Where's My Refund, via the automated line 800-829-1954, or by filing Form 3911 (Taxpayer Statement Regarding Refund); married-filing-jointly filers must use the form or call 800-829-1040.

If the check was cashed by someone else, the Bureau of the Fiscal Service sends a claim package (up to six weeks for review); if it was never cashed, a replacement is issued once the original is canceled.

Redeem points for gift cards (Amazon, Target, Walmart, Starbucks, etc.) starting at 3,000 points ($3).
